'''Stones Falling from the Cliff''' is a [[sword form]]. Nothing but the name is known about this form. It was used in the duel between [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Turak Aladon]]. The opposing side used this form to counter [[Ribbon in the Air]].{{ref/book|2|45}}
